mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.station_id AS stationId, s.station_name AS stationName, o.pile_code AS pileNo, CASE WHEN p.pile_type = 'dc' THEN '快充' WHEN p.pile_type = 'ac' THEN '慢充' ELSE p.pile_type END AS chargeType, o.start_time AS startTime, o.end_time AS endTime, o.duration, o.total_energy AS energy, o.total_amount AS amount, o.energy_price AS electricFee, o.service_price AS serviceFee, o.discount_amount AS discountAmount, o.order_status AS `status`, CASE WHEN o.order_status = '0' THEN '充电中' WHEN o.order_status = '1' THEN '已完成' WHEN o.order_status = '2' THEN '已取消' ELSE o.order_status END AS statusText, o.pay_status AS payStatus, o.create_time AS createTime FROM stad_charging_order o LEFT JOIN stad_charging_station s ON o.station_id = s.station_id LEFT JOIN stad_charging_pile p ON o.pile_id = p.pile_id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stad_charging_order ( order_no, user_id, station_id, pile_code, pile_id, start_time, total_energy, total_amount, energy_price, service_price, order_status, pay_status, create_time ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{stationId}, #{pileNo}, #{pileId}, NOW(), #{energy}, #{amount}, #{electricPrice}, #{servicePrice}, '0', '0', NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE stad_charging_order SET end_time = NOW(), duration = #{duration}, total_energy = #{energy}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, energy_price = #{electricFee}, service_price = #{serviceFee}, order_status = '1', pay_status = '0' WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND order_status = '0'
UPDATE stad_charging_order SET order_status = '2' WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND order_status = '0'
